{{Infobox auto}}

A '''sweet berry Danish''' is the meal of [[Sweet Berries|sweet berries]]. It heals {{Value|Sweet Berry Danish|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} {{Value|Sweet Berry Danish|level|effect=Health Boost}}, 4 extra hearts of maximum health, for {{Value|Sweet Berry Danish|duration|effect=Health Boost}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/sweet_berry_danish.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Sweet Berry Mash|Sweet berry mash]], sugar, [[cheese]] and dough. Obtaining sweet berry mash unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating one takes {{Value|Sweet Berry Danish|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Sweet Berry Danish|heals}} and gives Health Boost {{Value|Sweet Berry Danish|level|effect=Health Boost}} for {{Value|Sweet Berry Danish|duration|effect=Health Boost|format=clock}}.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_33.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
